freshman.decision: Do not advance sparse continuation from these energy numbers. Move the same frozen design to an external or cumulative-energy meter.
freshman.headline: We ran the right comparison, but the power sensor was too slow to answer it.
freshman.plain_answer: All 32 planned GPU runs completed from the exact LC3 warm state. Polling every 20 ms did not create 20 ms evidence: the board-power reading effectively changed about every 495 ms. The frozen rules therefore reject the energy comparison.
